scope: spidermap only; common RSU and OBU transmit power is the sole experimental variable
baseline_policy: Rerun eight 13 dBm runs with current binary; compare sealed historical requests. Baseline reruns avoid mixing runtime source versions.

goal_definition.mean_order: Naive > VTDF > RTVTDF > NN in both full and focus windows

fine_rule: If coarse best misses any goal condition, test best minus and plus 0.5 dBm on the same two development seeds. Otherwise no fine scan. Select once from development data before confirmation.
confirmation_policy: Freeze candidate before any confirmation result. Do not retune or change seeds after confirmation; report all five seeds even if ranking fails.
